scenario: Sub-day duration on Date per LTIM.4.2.2 — adding a `Duration` to a `Date` requires the duration to be a whole multiple of 24 hours. Sub-day additions reject. Pin: `some_date + 12_h` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_DATE_SUBDAY_ARITHMETIC; the diagnostic should point at `Date` having no time-of-day.
rules_ds:
schema Sched scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    d: Date mutable
    target: Date mutable

rule trig:
    Sched s where s.target == s.d + 12_h
->
    log info "hit"
